additional_info.subject: Y2 / R2 312900727010- Software problem
additional_info.body:
Dear Team,
We have a problem with the charging station, I think it's a software problem or configuration files.
The charging station has lost communication for the last two days, and today it turned out when I got to the website, the main screen of the charging station was under Hello/Hallo, I checked the routers, and both were connected.
In addition, there was no connection with the charging station in SCB, but strange logs appeared, please search the logs from today.
The charging station was under the latest software update v6.0.3-0 and I performed a flash operation for the C-fast card with the latest update, along with the configuration files corresponding to this charging station.
After two attempts, and each flash attempt that took at least an hour and a half, I encountered a failure.
Throughout the flash procedure, the screen was scrambled, and nothing seemed to progress.
In the third and final attempt, I tried to downgrade the update to V4.011 and encountered the same failure.
I am attaching 2 pictures and a video from a charging station.
Please help us find a solution as soon as possible, this is a very critical station.
Br,
Orel.

additional_info.subject: Site visit planned for Feb 16th, 09:00 AM Israel time (~12:30 PM IST)
additional_info.body:
Inputs from the Service Team:
The charger HMI got stuck. The RC rebooted the charger, but the issue persisted.
The RC attempted a CFast flash multiple times using v6.0.3 and v4.0.11, but it failed.
During the configuration restore process, the charger HMI displayed scrambled screen.
Action Items:
Before attempting the CFast flash,
check the HMI connections, especially the DP cable.
reset the router passwords to “admin01”.
If all connections are proper, proceed with the CFast flash and restore_config.

additional_info.subject: Site intervention on 16 Feb 2025
additional_info.body:
Checked DP cable and connections. Everything seems fine. But still there was scramble image on HMI.
Then we tried flashing Cfast, PLC(KF1) was unable to detect Cfast card. There was no command to insert Cfast card.
Charger was rebooting at 6% many times.
Checked LED on PLC- RN led was orange at first, after that no led. PWR led was green.
Tried getting dump data as well, but was unable to extract.
We suspected that, it can be the issue with KF1. Hence, tried with the new one.
After changing PLC, we were able to receive commands/instructions on HMI and restore config worked well. Which means there was no issue with live linux USB or CFast card.
Charger was online on SCB and Outlets were available.

additional_info.subject: Update
additional_info.body: After replacing KF1, the charger worked fine, but then XF4 became faulty (IP lost, Eth. port LED blinking without an Eth. connection). XF4 also needs replacement. The charger is down again, and RC will plan another site visit (date not confirmed)

additional_info.subject: Site intervention on 17 Feb 2025
additional_info.body:
Replaced router XF4.
Charging is working now- SCB & OCPP both are online, both outlets available.
